note: Frozen BEFORE any arm was run. Oracles are deterministic string/regex checks, not LLM judgments. 'expect' = must appear; 'forbid' = marks a wrong/hallucinated answer.

questions.q: When this codebase builds an HNSW graph, what is the default maximum number of connections per node? Give the constant name, its value, and the file that defines it.
What exact formula does the default BM25 scoring implementation use to compute IDF from docFreq and docCount? Write the expression.
What is the maximum length, in bytes, of a single indexed term, and how is that limit derived? Give the numeric value and the two constants involved.
questions.why: Requires resolving MAX_TERM_LENGTH = BYTE_BLOCK_SIZE - 2 across two files (IndexWriter -> ByteBlockPool). Tests reference-chasing, where symbol-level top-k can stop one hop short.

questions.q: What is the default RAM buffer size (in MB) that the index writer uses before flushing, and which constant holds it?
When you open a filesystem directory without naming a concrete implementation, what decides which implementation you actually get, and what are the two possible outcomes?
questions.why: The question deliberately contains none of the answer's identifiers. Tests semantic matching, not keyword grep.

questions.q: What is the default limit on the number of clauses a boolean query may contain, and in which class is that limit actually defined?
questions.why: Every engineer expects this in BooleanQuery; it lives in IndexSearcher. BooleanQuery only READS it. A retriever that returns the highest-scoring BooleanQuery hit answers with the wrong file.

questions.q: List every concrete non-test class in this repository that directly extends the abstract filesystem Directory base class. Give all of them.
questions.why: Exhaustiveness. A top-k retriever silently truncates and returns 2 of 3, with no signal that it was incomplete. RAFDirectory lives in lucene/misc, far from the other two.

questions.q: In the default merge policy, what percentage of deleted documents is tolerated in the index before merges are triggered to reclaim them, and what is the field called?
What is the minimum Java language version this project requires to build, and which file declares it?
questions.why: GUARANTEED RETRIEVAL LOSS, included deliberately. The index holds only parsed source symbols; .toml/.gradle files are not in it at all. Any honest post must report that the index cannot answer build-config questions.

questions.q: Outside of tests and benchmarks, which classes in this repository call forceMerge on an index writer? Name them.
questions.why: Reachability. docs/research/wordpress-verification-and-xerj-vs-grep.md already found XERJ's structured call graph WORSE than grep here, with silent false negatives. Included so that precedent is re-tested, not dodged.
